outcome: Differential expression of circRNAs (rno_circ_0005139, rno_circ_0006880, rno_circ_0011386, rno_circ_0000436, rno_circ_0009285, rno_circ_0014367)
Differential expression of mRNAs (Wnt5a, Wnt10b, Wnt2b)
cohort: Sixty-six pregnant Wistar rats were used, with their embryos harvested for anorectal tissue analysis.
finding: Rno_circ_0005139 influences cell proliferation and apoptosis by acting as a miR-324-3p sponge, thereby downregulating Wnt5a, suggesting a role in the molecular mechanisms of anorectal malformations (ARM).
